requestOutcomes.outcome: Official county publication retrieved. It is attributed to the Haiyan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and publishes the 2021-2035 county spatial plan; it is planning evidence, not an open parcel API.

Official county overview URL was attempted with a bounded 20-second request and timed out locally. Search discovery still identified the official county portal and Haiyan geography. This is not evidence of remote unavailability or cadastral absence.

Official Zhejiang Geographic Information Public Service Platform landing page retrieved. It advertises online map, resource-center, geocoding and developer-center functions. The landing page did not expose a parcel layer URL or anonymous parcel schema.
The linked platform-app root returned a gateway error. No retry escalation, login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was attempted.
The current landing-page JavaScript route was inspected. It resolved to an anti-bot/interstitial HTML response rather than usable viewer configuration; no parcel service endpoint was extracted.

Official Haiyan Natural Resources and Planning Bureau material was identified in first-party discovery. Its text describes county natural-resources, cadastral/rights-survey, registration-system and public geospatial-platform duties; no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No parcel response obtained; zero is not an absence finding.
